description: A Flutter widget implementing a phone number entry and social sign-in screen with testing bypass features, navigation to OTP verification and home screens, and UI elements styled to match app theme.

classes.name: OTPValidationScreen
classes.description: Stateful widget representing the OTP validation and login screen with social sign-in options and testing bypass.

classes.name: _OTPValidationScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the UI and logic for OTPValidationScreen, including input handling, social sign-in, and testing bypass.

methods.name: _buildSocialButton
methods.description: Creates styled social sign-in buttons with icon, label, and callback.

methods.name: _onContinueTap
methods.description: Handles tap on Continue button, including triple-tap bypass detection.

methods.name: _bypassLoginForTesting
methods.description: Debug method to bypass OTP flow and navigate directly to home, setting preferences accordingly.

methods.name: _onContinueWithPhone
methods.description: Validates phone input and navigates to OTP second screen if valid.

methods.name: _onGoogleSignIn
methods.description: Simulates Google sign-in, sets preferences, and navigates to home screen.
